hero.subtitle: Build your group workouts in minutes. Exercise library, programming methods, videos, and AI suggestions - all in one place, no credit card required.

without_items: Scattered spreadsheets that are hard to maintain
No visual reference for technical exercises
Exporting and sharing programs is a hassle
with_items: Videos linked directly to each exercise
Professional PDF generated in one click
Reusable workout library cycle after cycle

features.title: Exercise library
features.desc: A large exercise database by category - weightlifting, gymnastics, cardio, strength. Each movement is linked to a reference video.

features.title: Workout builder
features.desc: Choose your exercises, apply a training method (AMRAP, EMOM, For Time, Rounds...) and configure session rules in a few clicks.

features.title: AI suggestions
features.desc: AI analyzes your programming and suggests variations, progressions, or exercise combinations aligned with your goals.

features.title: Reference videos
features.desc: Attach a video to every exercise in your library. Athletes can see the expected technique before each WOD.

features.title: PDF export
features.desc: Generate a clean professional workout sheet in one click. Perfect for in-box display or sharing with your group.

features.title: Mobile-first PWA
features.desc: Install the app directly on your phone. Fast access on the gym floor, even with limited connectivity.

steps.title: Build your library
steps.desc: Add your exercises with descriptions, muscle groups, and reference videos. Reusable forever.

steps.title: Create your workout
steps.desc: Select your exercises, choose a method (AMRAP, EMOM...) and configure session rules.

steps.title: Refine with AI
steps.desc: Ask AI for suggestions to vary, progress, or balance your training load.

steps.title: Export and share
steps.desc: Generate the PDF and share the session with your group. Display it in your box or send it directly.

demo.subtitle: Discover how WODBUD speeds up WOD creation, structures your cycles, and simplifies sharing with your athletes. We show practical use cases adapted to your context.
